n.quote: A fresh sample of 36 participants was recruited (24 females and 12 males, mean age 24.83 years). Two participants were replaced because they made more than 10% errors.

n.exclusions: Two participants with more than 10% errors were replaced. Incorrect responses and RTs outside 150–1500 ms (0.05% and 0.88%) were excluded from RT analyses.

notes:
Sources verified by title/reference. Original reports η² as printed; no conversion to partial eta squared. Quotes normalize HTML line breaks and superscripts. Replication wiki is the primary authors’ summary and reports the after-exclusion sample. Replication extraction selects the wiki’s explicitly described bimodal Flanker effect, not the separate congruency × modality interaction.
Completion source review (es_value_o): The three-condition mean correct-RT ANOVA is directly identified in Experiment 2. Preserve printed η² = 0.57 without inferring a partial metric.
Completion source review (pval_value_o): Same mean correct-RT ANOVA as the extracted η²; preserve strict printed bound p < .01.
